data.name: Amaarah
data.gender_notes: Amaarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A mother who leads her people, nurtures them, and guides them to happiness and success. The name Amaarah carries the meaning “Mother of the people” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Amaarah usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a mother who is deeply spiritual and devoted to her family and community.
data.etymology: Amaarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amaarah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أمارة
in_arabic.meaning: أمارة تعني العلامة أو الدليل أو الشيء الذي يدل على شيء ما
in_arabic.long_meaning: أمارة هي كلمة عربية مشتقة من أصل 'أَمَرَ' الذي يعني الأمر أو العلامة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم مصطلح أمارة للإشارة إلى العلامة أو الدليل الذي يدل على شيء معين. في سياق الأسماء، يُعتبر اسم أمارة تعبيرًا عن الخصال الحميدة أو الصفات الجيدة التي يتصف بها الشخص، حيث يمكن أن يُفهم كعلامة أو دليل على الخير أو النجاح.

in_urdu.name: امارہ
in_urdu.meaning: امارہ کا مطلب ہے علامت، دليل یا کوئی ایسا چیز جو کسی چیز کی نشاندہی کرے
in_urdu.long_meaning: امارہ ایک عربی لفظ ہے جو 'أَمَرَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حکم یا علامت. اردو میں، امارہ کو علامت یا دليل کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے جو کسی چیز کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے. نام کے طور پر، امارہ ان خوبصورت گুণوں یا صفات کی نمائش کرتا ہے جو کسی فرد کے پاس ہوتے ہیں، جیسے کہ خوبی یا کامیابی کی علامت.

in_hindi.long_meaning: अमाराह एक अरबी शब्द है जो 'أَمَرَ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आदेश या चिह्न. हिंदी में, अमाराह को एक चिह्न या प्रमाण के रूप में समझा जाता है जो किसी वस्तु की ओर संकेत करता है. नाम के रूप में, अमाराह उन अच्छे गुणों या विशेषताओं को प्रदर्शित करता है जो किसी व्यक्ति के पास होते हैं, जैसे कि अच्छाई या सफलता का प्रतीक.

in_english.name: Amaarah
in_english.meaning: Amaarah means a sign, indication, or a thing that points to something
in_english.long_meaning: Amaarah is derived from the Arabic root 'أَمَرَ' (amara), which means to command or to signify. In the context of names, Amaarah signifies a mark, sign, or indication of good qualities, virtues, or success. Etymologically, it relates to the concept of something that points to or indicates another thing. Historically, names like Amaarah have been used in Islamic tradition to bestow blessings or to reflect desirable attributes. Spiritually, the name Amaarah may symbolize guidance, righteousness, or a positive influence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Amaarah holds a powerful cultural impact as it signifies a strong and inspirational leader. In Islamic culture, motherhood is highly respected, and the nurturing, loving, and guiding role of a mother is viewed as a profound influence on a child's development and the future of a society. Amaarah, meaning "a mother who leads her people," embodies the ideal of a powerful and selfless maternal figure who not only cares for and raises her children but also leads her community towards prosperity. This cultural significance can be seen in various historical female leaders in Islamic history who have led their people and defeated considerable challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Amaarah holds immense spiritual significance as it represents the concept of nurturing and guiding souls towards salvation and happiness both in the worldly and spiritual realms. In the Islamic faith, God (Allah) is referred to as the best of protectors and providers, and mothers are considered His vicegerents on earth, as they play a critical role in providing for their children and ensuring their growth and well-being. The name Amaarah highlights the essential role of a mother as not only a nurturer but a mentor and guide to her children and community, leading them towards the path of righteousness and success. Spiritually, it reminds us of the importance of caring, loving, and guiding others and inspiring them to be the best version of themselves.
